reuse.why: Adds the guard to link.ts beside the existing assertAccountNotLinked and calls it the same way, though each link function already loads the upgrading account right after and could have checked closed there.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only a one-line call is repeated in the six per-provider link functions, which are themselves copies in this tree.

placement.why: Link preconditions live in accounts/link.ts, exactly where assertAccountNotLinked is.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and testable; a seventh provider must remember to call two asserts, since there is no single linking entry point.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Follows the link.assertAccountNotLinked pattern in every provider.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-provider call is a single line.

one_place.where: assertAccountOpen in server/accounts/link.ts, called by all six link*Account functions in accounts/app.ts.
